q1_top10_1h.label: 최근 1시간 가장 많이 본 글 TOP10
q1_top10_1h.mysql_sql: SELECT /*bench_q1*/ review_id, COUNT(*) c FROM view_events_bench WHERE viewed_at >= (SELECT MAX(viewed_at) FROM view_events_bench) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY review_id ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
q1_top10_1h.clickhouse_sql: SELECT /*bench_q1*/ review_id, count() c FROM shelfeed.view_events_bench WHERE viewed_at >= (SELECT max(viewed_at) FROM shelfeed.view_events_bench) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY review_id ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10

q2_unique_viewers.label: 글별 순 방문자 수 TOP10
q2_unique_viewers.mysql_sql: SELECT /*bench_q2*/ review_id, COUNT(DISTINCT viewer) u FROM view_events_bench GROUP BY review_id ORDER BY u DESC LIMIT 10
q2_unique_viewers.clickhouse_sql: SELECT /*bench_q2*/ review_id, uniqExact(viewer) u FROM shelfeed.view_events_bench GROUP BY review_id ORDER BY u DESC LIMIT 10
